source: Intel ARK, Core i9-10900X: 4 memory channels (quad-channel DDR4), so 4 x 64-bit = 256-bit. The 8 installed modules are two per channel and do not widen the bus; the system snapshot records modules, not channels. Confirmed by measurement: C++ mem_triad reached 52.6 GB/s on 10 threads, above the 42.7 GB/s a dual-channel DDR4-2666 bus could deliver.
Self-built machine: the board leaves the DMI strings at their defaults, so the snapshot records vendor "System manufacturer" and product "System Product Name". There is no OEM to name.
